findings.summary: R1 exit box 1 (NFR-I18N-001, a Must of R1) is open and its text is stale; the requirement is only partly met: M11.71 (command, tool and menu titles by id) and M11.72 (the player's chrome strings) are todo and five player strings sit in scripts/gates/i18n-allowlist.json. check-trace and check-i18n are green only because of the allowlist and a title naming the ID. Ticking box 1 now would be dishonest.

Release enablement (M1 final F2), fast-check out of @fluxion/schema's runtime dependencies (M2 final F6) and CODE_SCANNING (M1 final F1) were handed to M11 ('first release is M11') and have no M11 row.
M11.59 (older-WebKit nightly findings) is todo with no owner; M11.66/M11.67 hand the visual-xos baselines to M32 item 11 without a Deferred entry.

No gate leg holds NFR-I18N-001 open: nothing checks check-i18n, an empty player allowlist, or M9.19/M9.20/M11.71/M11.72 being done; the CI-evidence leg needs the review range to end at the last code commit; the five-projects leg is a name match, the CI evidence file proves the runs.

ADR-0160 widens the licence policy and names harness, not the human, as decision-maker; bounded (one package, one licence, check-drift reports a widening) but the human should acknowledge it at sign-off. ADR-0158 and ADR-0161 raised NFR-DX-002 about 3x and 4x on one box's timings.

The i18n value pattern holds in production (editor dist and studio bundle contain activate('en')), but only a Vitest test against source covers it; no test asserts the studio's production bundle renders English text.
Box 2 cites run 37375690437 at 6cdbad4; later code commits (lockfile, Lingui, gate changes) are not covered by it.

Plan health: 26 planned rows grew to 72 (about 2.8x). Causes: M10 rows open at start, webkit and visual flake and nightly findings, gate-budget growth, lockfile commits blocked by the budget, Lingui landing late. The Learned section is empty.
